title: Studio website launch review
subtitle: A proposed release process for a small static website.

pages.title: Release plan
pages.markdown:
![A diagram showing source content passing through build and review to Cloudflare Pages, with a rollback path](./assets/release-path.webp "Proposed release path · Example diagram")

Use a static build and a preview deployment before the public release. The site needs a homepage, a work index, individual project pages and a contact route. It does not need a database for the first version.

### Proposed scope

| Area | First release | Later |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Work | Selected projects with supplied images | Search and filtering |
| Content | Versioned Markdown files | A CMS, if editing becomes a bottleneck |
| Hosting | Static assets on Cloudflare Pages | Functions only when a real feature requires them |
| Contact | Email link | Form with spam protection |

### Approval gates

1. **Content:** every project has reviewed text and approved images.
2. **Build:** generated files and links are checked.
3. **Preview:** desktop and mobile layouts are reviewed.
4. **Publish:** the previous working release remains available for rollback.

> [!NOTE]
> This is an example planning document. It describes a proposed setup, not a completed deployment.

pages.title: Build & configuration
Review checklist
pages.markdown:
### Content

- [x] Agree the page list.
- [x] Choose the first set of projects.
- [ ] Review titles, dates and project descriptions.
- [ ] Confirm image rights and write useful alt text.

### Behaviour

- [ ] Test navigation and outgoing links.
- [ ] Check keyboard focus and page headings.
- [ ] Test narrow screens and large text.
- [ ] Check image sizes and loading behaviour.

### Before publishing

- **DNS:** confirm the intended domain.
- **Redirects:** preserve any existing project URLs.
- **Rollback:** record the previous deployment.
  - Who can restore it?
  - Where is the approved build stored?
  - How will the team confirm the rollback worked?

> [!WARNING]
> Do not remove the old deployment until the new public URL has been checked.

---

### Open decisions

| Decision | Owner | Needed before |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Final project selection | Content editor | Preview review |
| Public domain | Site owner | Publishing |
| Contact email | Site owner | Content sign-off |

There are no assigned dates in this example. Add real owners and dates before using it as a release checklist.
